title: Welcome to the Sunflower Circus!
overview: In 1950s Japan, penniless Mizuka meets two circus girls, sparking a dream-filled new beginning.

title: That Was So Dazzling
overview: The "Sunflower Circus" is headed to Toyokawa, a popular and officially sanctioned performance venue.

title: I Don't Want to Show My Scars
overview: Determined to surpass "Shiny Lavender", the "Sunflower Circus" prepares for its upcoming show.

title: I Just Can't Bring Myself to Be Honest
overview: The "Sunflower Circus" had a successful show in Toyokawa, but their earnings were seized by debt collectors.

title: There Is Nowhere I Belong
overview: Akane storms off as Mizuka searches the mountains for Rafflesia Circus’s missing François.

title: A Sinister Legend Summons a Storm
overview: Nanami Sumeragi’s team makes headlines with newspapers asking if they could surpass the "Lotus Circus."

title: I Don't Get the Circus
overview: Mizuka, determined to challenge Mitscher, returns to the group members who all look very serious.

title: This Is What I Always Wanted
Is All That Kindness Just a Lie?
overview: Maria collapses from exhaustion, and Rin fiercely scolds the troupe for causing chaos at the hospital.

title: Beyond the Stage of Dreams
overview: The "Sunflower Circus" has been granted permission to participate in the "Circus Collection Japan Tournament."
